title: Recent-Claim Holdback on Rental Sale Cancellation Credits
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts sale cancellation credit carries a recent-claim holdback set by the benefit authorizations issued on the contract in the month before the confirmation.

| Benefit authorizations issued on the contract in the month before the confirmation | Together, compared with the notice-period installment | Recent-claim holdback |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | at least the installment | 0.40 |
| one or more | below the installment | 0.20 |
| none | — | 0 |

The notice-period installment is the installment billed for the billing period in which notice was given.

**Records read.** The benefit authorizations in the contract's claim records, with their amounts and dates.

**How the holdback acts.** The holdback is subtracted from one on its own, and the credit is multiplied by what remains as a separate multiplier, before the single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* notice-period installment $61.74; one authorization of $450.00 three weeks before the confirmation: 0.40, so the credit keeps 0.60 of its amount on this account. An authorization of $40.00 only: 0.20.
